itemized_evaluation.justification: The paper provides full funding source disclosures and an explicit conflict of interest statement in the Declarations section: 'Competing interests. D.S. is the founder and a beneficiary of FreshCredit Inc. and the founder of The FreshCredit Lab. FreshCredit Inc holds granted US utility patents... Funding. None received; independent research.'

The text explicitly identifies itself as an unreviewed preprint with pending institutional repository deposits: 'The companion theory preprint defines trust...' and 'Simulation code, seeds, figures, and pre-registration documents are deposited at OSF (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/TBD). The Supporting Document and Technical Appendix are in preparation... until they are deposited, the frozen-criteria and protocol claims that cite them are self-attested.'

Prior works and negative literature are thoroughly and accurately represented without selective framing, e.g., in Section 2.2: 'Against the “trust molecule” framing: the foundational intranasal-oxytocin trust effect is dead. Meta-analysis of the trust-game literature (pooled n = 481) finds a combined effect statistically indistinguishable from zero' and Section 4.4: 'The contested status must now be stated as plainly as the hypothesis, because the demolitions are substantial and come from both outside and inside the criticality camp.'

The paper explicitly evaluates independent replications (and failures to replicate) and establishes a reproducible protocol with exact seeds and byte-verified checkpoints: 'A genetics section evaluates loci by modern evidentiary standards — genome-wide significance and independent replication... The released TRIBE v2 checkpoint (facebook/tribev2 best.ckpt) was verified byte-exactly for this work — exactly 708,856,138 bytes... Repeat inference is bit-exact (max |Delta| = 0.0).'

Sampling selection and author-selection biases are explicitly controlled or remedied via randomized sampling and blinded rating protocols, e.g., Section 5.7: 'A frozen uniform sample of 12,000 post-synaptic roots (seed 45...)' and Section 5.2: 'The author-selection limitation of §4.6... now has a specified remedy, pre-registered before rating begins: minimum three independent raters per artifact... blind to the framework’s hypotheses and to author assignments'.

Explicit power calculations and large sample sizes are documented throughout, e.g., Section 5.1: 'N = 60 enrolled -> 48 completers (20% multi-session attrition)... Power at N = 48: 0.78–0.92 for the per-probe test at d_z = 0.5–0.6 (alpha = 0.01, Bonferroni over five confirmatory tests)... and 0.92 for the pooled test at d_z = 0.5, alpha = 0.05'.

Proper controls (permutation nulls, shuffle controls, semantic-only controls) and double-blinding are explicitly incorporated, e.g., Section 5.1: 'DOCAS-GATE-1: a double-blind, placebo-controlled, within-subject crossover with 7 sessions per participant' and Section 5.5: 'E3 — shuffling the update stream (breaking the temporal operator coupling) destroys the law in 200/200 negative-control replicates — PASS'.

Appropriate statistical tests (Mantel tests, permutation tests, one-way ANOVA, Tukey-Kramer HSD, TOST equivalence) are paired with explicit effect sizes (OR, Cohen's d, eta^2, R^2, Pearson r), e.g., Section 5.18: 'In omnibus one-way ANOVA across the four regimes, metric hierarchy tau yielded F(3, 9996) = 3,561.48 (p < 10^-15, large effect size eta^2 = 0.5166 vs. frozen >= 0.140; PASS).' and Section 5.4: 'TRIBE v2 is deterministic, so its within-run temporal variability is not measurement noise and supplies no valid effect-size denominator; a Cohen’s d computed against it is uninterpretable as an effect size.'

Randomization, counterbalancing, and group/condition allocations are fully detailed, e.g., Section 5.1: 'session order counterbalanced by a Williams-balanced assignment over the six probes (48 = 8 x 6 preserves the balance), with the placebo session at a fixed position. N = 60 enrolled -> 48 completers' and Section 5.7: '12,000 post-synaptic roots (seed 45; 8,256 class-typed, spanning 11 classes from 23P and 4P through basket, Martinotti, and neurogliaform cells)'.

Exact p-values, confidence intervals, standard errors, and permutation bounds are rigorously reported throughout, e.g., Section 4.2: 'lead SNP rs7528604, p = 5.39 x 10^-11, OR = 0.89 (95% CI 0.86–0.92)... failed its lookup in the largest independent anxiety GWAS — UK Biobank... rs7528604 p = .18, OR = 0.97 (95% CI 0.93–1.02)' and Section 5.14: 'beta_IVW(ADCY8) = 0.2284 (SE = 0.0223, p = 2.4 x 10^-24)'.

Raw numbers, baseline metrics, and absolute values are consistently provided alongside relative ratios and percentages, e.g., Section 4.6: 'within-set density 0.267 (12/45 edges)... background density is 0.0027', Section 5.13: '96.7% vs. 0.0%', and Section 5.17: 'rejected by 98.3% of rational Fehr–Schmidt agents under transparent disclosure (1.7% baseline emergency uptake) were accepted by 95.7% of agents under multimodal cloaking... bottom cognitive bandwidth decile (D_1) suffered an exploitation odds ratio of 16.12x relative to the top decile (D_10, 98.0% vs. 75.2% uptake)'.

Exclusions, unmapped items, attrition, and indeterminate runs are fully logged and accounted for, e.g., Section 5.4: '114 of 196 content words mapped to Concepticon nodes (tiered matching fully logged: 52 exact gloss, 19 morphological, 43 via a documented synonym table; 82 unmapped, mostly finance jargon with no Concepticon gloss)' and Section 5.6: 'Four studies, each fully pre-registered with frozen PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE criteria before any criterion-relevant data were touched; INDETERMINATE outcomes are reported, never dropped.'

The paper explicitly refuses to swap true biological endpoints for convenient surrogate or computational markers, repeatedly stating the exact scope of its proxies, e.g., Abstract: 'All in-silico evidence reported here is instrument-level: no neurochemistry was measured anywhere in this paper' and Section 5: 'it tests pipeline decodability and separable channel signatures, not the carrier mapping — HRV, sleep, and activity measures are several inference steps from neuromodulatory tone and cannot distinguish the named carriers; pharmacological or PET-level perturbation is the actual gate for carrier claims'.

Statistical significance is strictly separated from practical/construct validity and magnitude of correspondence, e.g., Section 1.1: 'the delivered cross-geometry correspondence is Mantel r = 0.252 (cortical) and 0.240 (embedding), with a recorded null on out-of-distribution stimuli (§4.6) — correlation, not isometry' and Section 4.6: 'the N.3 category-LOO decode survives every correction while being a known artifact (templatic lexicon; the semantic-only control also decodes at 1.000) — multiplicity correction controls the false-positive rate, not construct validity'.

Correlation is explicitly distinguished from causation and confounding variables (such as LD, pleiotropy, and expectancy) are rigorously addressed, e.g., Section 4.7: 'Because every tier of gene-level evidence available to this framework is associational, we state explicitly what publicly available in-silico resources can and cannot license... convergent associational tiers, not causal claims... Because no tier is causal and the genetic tiers substantially re-descend from circular legacy genetics, this triangulation licenses no causal claim'.

In the provided paper text, all figures are embedded as broken/external local file links (e.g., '') that cannot be visually inspected for axis baselines, and the text explicitly admits that several numbered figures are missing entirely: 'The architecture schematic (Figure 1), the core-battery TRIBE v2 summary (Figure 3), and the original-battery flatmap (Figure 6) have no deposited image files and are therefore not typeset as floats'.

Hypotheses and criteria were pre-specified and frozen prior to execution, failed criteria are reported plainly as failures, and any post-hoc analyses are explicitly quarantined and labeled as carrying no evidential weight, e.g., Section 5.5: 'E2 — the failure, stated plainly: the framework failed its pre-registered double-dissociation criterion as frozen... The failure is not re-narrated as support. What follows is post-hoc hypothesis generation, labeled as such... carries no evidential weight for the current framework'.

Study timeframes, physiological timescales, washout periods, and multi-generational simulation horizons are logically matched to the biological and dynamical phenomena under study, e.g., Section 1: 'Because the five neuromodulatory systems involved operate on timescales spanning more than four orders of magnitude (0.1 s to ~2,700 s)...', Section 5.1: '7 sessions per participant... >=7-day washouts... ~8–12 weeks per participant', and Section 5.22: 'G = 50 generations'.

Extrapolation limits, out-of-distribution failures, and non-linear boundary conditions are explicitly enforced and documented, e.g., Section 4.6: 'Single words are, however, out-of-distribution input for instruments trained on naturalistic narrative... these models’ representational geometry is stimulus-class-sensitive', Section 4.2: 'resolved through the classic Arnsten inverted-U profile of prefrontal cortical cAMP signaling', and Section 5.4: 'the translated cloud shrinks toward the centroid (ridge regression-to-mean)'.

The entire architecture is explicitly revised and constrained to respect physiological, mathematical, and thermodynamic boundaries, e.g., Abstract: 'Because the five neuromodulatory systems involved operate on timescales spanning more than four orders of magnitude... no serial five-step cascade is physiologically coherent. DOCAS is therefore framed here as a parallel, multi-timescale modulation architecture', Section 2.4: 'catecholamines do not cross the blood–brain barrier : circulating epinephrine cannot be the carrier of a central activation signal', and Section 2.9: 'The component-wise non-negative vector... is what the theory’s Fisher–Rao construction normalizes into the stage-mix simplex coordinate theta... the simplex applies to these non-negative activities, not to the signed components of T.'
